newsitem.title: USA: Shoe Carnival May same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Shoe Carnival May same store sales rise.

text.p: Shoe Carnival Inc, a large retailer of footwear and accessories, said Thursday its comparable store sales for the four-week period ended May 31, 1997 rose 2.5 percent from the same period last year.
Total sales increased three percent to $19.7 million from sales of $19.1 million for the four-week period ended June 1, 1996.

Sales for the first four months of fiscal 1997 increased 2.2 percent to $79.0 million from sales of $77.3 million for the first four months of 1996. Comparable store sales increased by 3.9 percent for the seventeen-week period.
Shoe Carnival operates 91 footwear stores located in the Midwest and Midsouth.
